relations.text: 子会社Priovantが2021年にファイザーと薬のライセンス・共同開発契約を結ぶ(Telavantも共同で設立)

source.quote: ("Pulmovant") entered into a license agreement (the "Bayer-Pulmovant License Agreement") with Bayer Aktiengesellschaft ("Bayer").

source.quote: ity interest in its majority-owned subsidiary Telavant to Roche Holdings, Inc. ("Roche")

relations.text: 2024年10月、子会社Dermavant(皮膚薬VTAMA)の全持分をオルガノンに売却
relations.text_en: Sold its entire stake in Dermavant (maker of VTAMA) to Organon in October 2024

source.quote: in October 2024 we completed the sale of our entire equity interest in our majority-owned subsidiary Dermavant Sciences Ltd. to Organon & Co.

relations.text: 大株主だった住友ファーマから約6.48億ドルで自社株を買い戻した

source.quote: including 71,251,083 shares repurchased from Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd. at $9.10 per share for approximately $648.4 million.
